title: no sensitive content in photos; the uploader confirms, a report hides

criteria.text: No image of a child, animal or pet, or anyone who can't fend for themselves; the uploader confirms, nothing is pre-screened
criteria.note: `PagePhotoPicker` waits for the tick and clears it after every upload; Page photo, Page picture and post photo all use it; the tick is client-side as ruled (#483); its label is now "No kids in this photo." (#1087) [V reread 2026-11-06]. Unclaimed-Page photos are staff-loaded under the stock-only rule, not a member upload; the daily seeds keep applying it (#1001 this week: youth programs go stock-only) [V] Checked: `[guards F080.1]` in `PagePhotoPicker.test.tsx:179`: every member photo surface goes through the one picker and the upload path imports no classifier, seen failing against four mutants (#901, closed #835) [V] Reviewed: #483 `review-skipped` [V] Shipped: #483 (0b26c0d) and #1087 (8b313b0) green [V] Smoked: unknown. The last green run covering `page-edit` is `smoke-live` 2026-11-01 (3df9260); #1172 and #1181 (2026-11-05, "Listed under") changed the editor after it, and no run has reached a signed-in screen since (11-02 red, 11-03 and 11-05 stalled at sign-in, fix #1190 merged 11-06) [V].

criteria.text: Text is not in scope; only images are restricted
criteria.note: Standing guard that no text or topic rule exists in `src` (#781) [V] Checked: `[guards F080.2]` in `f080-guards.test.ts:34` [V] Reviewed: #781 no `Reviewed by:` [V] Shipped: #781 (55e23a2) green [V] Smoked: an absence, no screen shows it [V].

criteria.text: A reported image is caught by F078: a sensitive-content flag hides at any bar and texts the operator
criteria.note: Sensitive content hides a Page picture or post photo past the limits and alerts the operator (#483); email through Resend until Twilio exists (#751; #707 open, unchanged this week) [V] Checked: `[guards F080.4]` in `f078-criteria.test.ts:358`: hides on the first report at a 0.99 bar from a struck-out reporter, alerts by email without Twilio and by SMS with it, seen failing against three mutants (#901) [V] Reviewed: #483 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: unknown. No run sends a report [V]. Since 2026-11-05 a member's own post (#1184) is reportable on the same path and a sensitive-content report hides it at once (`create.ts` `member_post`, `hideBar: 0`) [V].

criteria.text: On every Page and post surface (composers, Page editor, announce) the app asks not to post sensitive content; each photo upload asks to confirm it shows no children

criteria.text: The post-without-a-Page composer (#1183) asks too: wherever a member posts
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-06] `MemberPostComposer` (`src/components/member-posts/MemberPostComposer.tsx`, opened from `/neighbors/new`, merged 2026-11-05 in #1184) shows no safety line: `PostingSafetyNote` is imported by the Page composers, `PageEditor` and `PagePosts` only. It takes no photo, so the per-photo tick does not apply. `[guards F080.5]` pins the older surfaces and cannot see this one. The line itself is the PM's wording and Lost & found is a place to post a lost pet, so the question goes to the PM (#1207, needs-pm).

criteria.text: The ask at posting says why
criteria.note: RETIRED. Overtaken by the PM's call of 2026-10-27 (recorded in #1096's body, not yet in F080 `## Rulings`): only what is absolutely necessary at posting; the reasons stay in the publish step's agreement (F082), which is the attestation.
